chunks: Accursed is man. How ungrateful is he!

key_terms.قُتِلَ: Accursed or doomed (idiomatic expression of rebuke)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Qutila al-insan' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the incident of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ frowning at Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, illustrating how even the Prophet’s human reactions can be divinely corrected to teach spiritual humility. It emphasizes that ingratitude (kufr) is not merely theological denial but a practical failure to recognize and respond to divine signs, a theme central to the concept of *tazkiyah* (purification of the soul).
